jobs.description:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
- You will collaborate with building Operations, Operations Engineering teams, FC Start-up Team, AFT Software teams, ACES team, and Safety to support MHE systems optimization and project implementation
- You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
- You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
- You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

jobs.description: L'opportunité Vous serez responsable d’une plateforme sur laquelle les équipes de développement de Unity comptent pour exploiter des services en production. Celle-ci leur fournit un environnement Kubernetes géré dans des grappes partagées afin qu’elles puissent déployer et exploiter des applications sans avoir à mettre en place leur propre infrastructure. Elle prend actuellement en charge plus de 1 200 déploiements actifs et traite environ 30 millions de requêtes entrantes en production par jour. Il s’agit d’un poste principal, et cette distinction est importante. Vous définirez l’orientation technique de la plateforme plutôt que de mettre en œuvre la conception de quelqu’un d’autre. Vous déterminerez la façon de gérer l’architecture multilocataire, l’isolation et la conformité dans les grappes partagées, ainsi que les fonctions que la plateforme doit ou ne doit pas offrir. Vous veillerez ensuite à concrétiser ces décisions en production. Votre jugement influencera la manière dont des centaines de développeur(euse)s chez Unity livrent leur code. L’équipe est répartie dans le monde entier, et les outils que nous créons constituent la base sur laquelle les autres équipes s’appuient pour mettre leur travail en production de façon sûre et rapide. Nous sommes convaincu(e)s que rien de valable ne se construit en vase clos. Ce que vous allez faire Assurer la responsabilité de l’architecture et de la fiabilité d’une plateforme Kubernetes multilocataire : isolation des locataires, application des politiques, contrôle des admissions, attribution des coûts, conformité à la loi SOX et mise à l’échelle des grappes partagées à mesure que leur adoption augmente. Concevoir et livrer des fonctionnalités de plateforme, de la proposition initiale jusqu’à l’exploitation en production. Parmi les exemples récents figurent la gestion des secrets avec Vault, l’application des politiques au moyen de Kyverno, la migration de nginx-ingress vers la Gateway API, la mise à l’échelle automatique axée sur les événements avec KEDA, les ressources Config Connector, un fournisseur d’identité dédié à l’authentification de la plateforme et l’attribution des coûts par espace de noms. Définir l’orientation de la normalisation de l’infrastructure infonuagique chez Unity : déterminer quelles charges de travail conviennent à une plateforme partagée, quelles solutions de rechange sont possibles et comment les équipes peuvent effectuer la transition. ABOUT THE TEAM

The B2B Marketing team contributes to OpenAI's broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. We are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI's products and platform. We take a data-driven approach to understand our customers' needs and challenges, ensuring that their voices are reflected in product development and messaging. We then partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Sales, Research, Comms, and Design teams to create a cohesive customer experience across all our channels.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an enterprise Product Marketing Manager to own the administrator and governance experience across ChatGPT Work and Codex. IT administrators, security teams, and deployment owners are often the difference between an AI product being available and an organization actually putting it to work.

This role will define how OpenAI earns the trust of the people responsible for approving, deploying, managing, and expanding AI inside their organizations. You will translate a fast-moving set of enterprise capabilities into a clear, practical story covering setup, access, controls, governance, security, usage, and value.

You will own the administrator audience as a dedicated product marketing discipline, partnering closely with Product, Security, Sales, Customer Success, Growth, Customer Education, and other Marketing teams. Your job is not simply to announce new features. It is to help administrators understand what has changed, what they can control, how to deploy responsibly, and why expanding access is the right decision for their organization.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Own the IT administrator and governance audience: Build a deep understanding of the needs, decisions, objections, and workflows of workspace administrators, IT leaders, security teams, and enterprise deployment owners.

- Define the enterprise administration and governance story: Develop clear positioning and messaging across workspace setup, feature enablement, identity and access, roles and permissions, data and connector access, agent controls, auditability, analytics, and spend management.

- Lead administrator-focused product launches: Shape launch strategy, messaging, and readiness for capabilities that affect administration, deployment, governance, or control across ChatGPT Work and Codex.

- Make product changes understandable and actionable: Build a predictable administrator communications motion that explains what is changing, who is affected, what decisions or actions are required, and how customers can enable new capabilities responsibly.

- Create the materials that unblock deployment: Partner with Product, Security, Documentation, and customer-facing teams on practical setup guidance, governance explainers, deployment resources, FAQs, demos, and field enablement.

- Turn administrator insight into better product decisions: Bring recurring customer objections, implementation barriers, security questions, and adoption patterns back to Product and Engineering to inform priorities and roadmap tradeoffs.

- Build always-on administrator education and engagement: Develop coordinated programs across customer communications, webinars, peer learning, customer stories, lifecycle campaigns, and relevant in-product experiences.

- Connect administrative approval to broader adoption: Partner with Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and product marketing peers to move organizations from evaluation and approval to enablement, rollout, and sustained usage.

- Earn trust through accuracy and customer proof: Clearly distinguish available capabilities from future plans, represent controls and limitations honestly, and develop evidence that helps administrators make the case for responsible expansion.

- Measure administrator and deployment outcomes: Track the signals that matter, including eligible workspace enablement, time to deployment, adoption of relevant controls, field objections, administrator engagement, and confidence in enterprise readiness.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

- 8+ years of experience in enterprise product marketing or a closely related go-to-market role, ideally across SaaS, cloud platforms, security, identity, infrastructure, or AI products.

- Demonstrated experience marketing to IT administrators, security stakeholders, technical buyers, or the teams responsible for deploying and governing enterprise software.

- The ability to understand and explain technical concepts such as identity and access, provisioning, permissions, security controls, audit logs, compliance requirements, data access, and usage or spend management.

- A strong track record of bringing enterprise product capabilities to market and building the materials, programs, and field guidance that help customers adopt them.

- Excellent writing and messaging skills, with the ability to make complex product or governance decisions clear without overstating what is available.

- Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Sales, Customer Success, Customer Education, and Marketing teams.

- A customer-first approach grounded in research, direct conversations, support and field feedback, and an understanding of what makes enterprise administrators trust or reject a product.

- Strong analytical instincts and experience connecting marketing efforts to deployment, activation, adoption, or customer confidence rather than content engagement alone.

- Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where launch timing, product details, and customer needs can change quickly.

- Genuine interest in responsible AI deployment and the practical work required to help organizations adopt new technology safely and at scale.

WORKPLACE & LOCATION

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Occasional travel will be required.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Title and Summary Associate Consultant, Launch Graduate Program – 2027, Istanbul, Türkiye Why join Mastercard’s Launch Program? We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities. What you’ll do As an Associate Consultant, you will: • collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. • create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more. Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment

To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success.

Job Summary

The Senior Advisor, Trade Compliance, serves as the Company's principal non-attorney subject matter resource for import compliance execution and supports the integration of the Company's import and export compliance activities. This role has primary responsibility for carrying out the Company's import compliance program in daily practice, including customs entry oversight, tariff classification, valuation, country-of-origin determinations, and recordkeeping, and for translating program requirements into workable procedures for the business.

Reporting to the Lead Counsel, Import and Trade Compliance, the Senior Advisor, Trade Compliance, will work closely with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and outside trade advisors and will serve as a day-to-day technical resource on customs and trade regulatory questions arising across the enterprise.

The Senior Advisor, Trade Compliance, will support import program governance, CTPAT activities, regulatory filings and responses to U.S. Customs and Border Protection, special duty programs, audit remediation, and ERP and trade technology modernization initiatives.

Position Overview

Your Key Responsibilities may include:

Import Compliance Program Support

• Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Company's import compliance policies, procedures, and standards.
• Support the network of Import Compliance Single Points of Contact (SPOCs) across Supply Chain, Commercial, and other business units and functions.
• Determine and maintain import record retention requirements and documentation management processes for import transactions.

• Track audit remediation items and entry changes through closure.

Customs Operations and Broker Oversight

• Review customs broker entries for accuracy and completeness and engage with outside vendors on entry quality.
• Perform customs broker oversight, including broker surveys, periodic reviews, and adherence to the Company's broker management procedures.
• Support filings and responses to U.S. Customs and Border Protection, including responses to CF-28 requests for information and CF-29 notices, post summary corrections, and protests.

• Support CTPAT program activities, including annual audit preparation and evidence collection.

Classification, Valuation, and Special Duty Programs

• Serve as a technical resource on tariff classification, customs valuation, and country-of-origin determinations, and engage outside HTS classification experts where required.
• Support administration of Section 232 and Section 301 special duty programs.
• Support tax optimization initiatives involving free trade agreements, Chapter 98, duty drawback, and foreign trade zones.
• Support IEEPA-related refund and duty recovery efforts.

Supply Chain and Commercial Support

• Engage with Supply Chain to collect documentation needed for customs entries and to answer questions from brokers.
• Provide practical guidance to Supply Chain and Commercial regarding planned imports and cross-border transactions.
• Support Supply Chain on logistics issues that implicate customs compliance.

Export Compliance and Technology Integration

• Support alignment between the import and export compliance programs.
• Support ERP implementation and configuration changes affecting trade compliance.

Success Profile:

To thrive in this role, you’ll demonstrate the following Leadership Competencies:

Takes Accountability: Takes ownership of actions and follows through on commitments by courageously dealing with important problems, holding others accountable, and standing up for what is right.

Communicates Effectively: Invites dialogue to gain a shared understanding and influences with confidence to drive performance and achieve business results

Partners Collaboratively: Builds strong relationships based on trust and seeks opportunities to collaborate across the matrix/organizational boundaries to achieve business goals

Drives Performance: Delivers results through realistic planning to accomplish goals

Basic Requirements:

• Legally authorized to work in the United States.
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
• 7 or more years of experience in import compliance, customs, international trade, export compliance, or related regulatory matters.
• Demonstrated experience supporting or administering a trade compliance program in a complex corporate environment.
• Experience preparing and reviewing customs documentation, including entry summaries and supporting records.
• Working knowledge of:

• U.S. customs laws and regulations
• Customs valuation and tariff classification
• Import recordkeeping requirements
• CBP entry, post-entry, and enforcement processes

• Experience working directly with customs brokers and supporting responses to CBP inquiries.
• Strong organizational, project management, written communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
• Ability to effectively balance regulatory risk management with business objectives.

Preferred Requirements:

• Licensed Customs Broker, Certified Customs Specialist, or similar trade compliance designation.
• Working knowledge of export control and sanctions regulations.
• Experience supporting CTPAT programs, customs audits, prior disclosures, and government trade enforcement matters.
• Experience with non-U.S. customs and logistics.
• Experience with ERP systems, customs automation platforms, and other trade compliance technologies.
• Experience supporting multinational organizations with complex supply chain and global operations.
• Experience managing customs brokers, freight forwarders, and other third-party trade service providers.
• Experience developing and delivering trade compliance training to business stakeholders.
• Experience in the energy or industrial sector.

Oct 7, 2026

ConocoPhillips offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and career growth:

Taking Care of Your Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, mental health support, and wellness programs.

•

Supporting and Building Financial Security: Competitive base pay, annual performance bonuses, and retirement savings plans.

We don’t just offer jobs—we offer meaningful careers in a company that values how we work as much as what we achieve.

Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you'll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Generate Interest

Join LPL Financial's Client Technology Management (CTM) organization and play a critical role in supporting the technology solutions that power advisor success. As a Product Operations Associate, you will serve as a trusted resource for financial advisors, their staff, and internal business partners by helping manage technology access, troubleshooting operational issues, and supporting a broad portfolio of advisor-facing products.

This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise across multiple technology platforms, collaborate with teams throughout the organization, and contribute to an exceptional advisor experience. If you enjoy problem-solving, building relationships, and working in a fast-paced environment where your contributions make a meaningful impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

The Product Operations Associate supports the Client Technology Management (CTM) team by providing operational and product support for advisor technology platforms and services. This role is responsible for processing technology-related requests, responding to advisor inquiries, providing application support, and ensuring operational activities are completed accurately and in compliance with firm policies and procedures. The position partners closely with internal departments and external clients to deliver efficient service and support for technology products and platform access.

Responsibilities

•

Provide high-quality service and support to financial advisors, advisor staff, and internal business partners through phone, email, and operational support channels.

•

Process requests to add, modify, or remove access to advisor technology platforms and supported applications.

•

Support first-contact resolution efforts by assisting users with technology processes, systems, and platform navigation.

•

Provide application support for proprietary and third-party technology solutions, including troubleshooting access and operational issues.

•

Develop and maintain expertise in CTM-supported products and services to assist advisors and internal stakeholders with technology-related needs.

•

Deliver training, guidance, and operational knowledge sharing to processing and service teams.

•

Participate in and lead meetings related to product enhancements, process improvements, project initiatives, and operational updates.

•

Perform product reconciliation, data analysis, reporting, and information gathering activities as required.

•

Communicate product requirements, operational procedures, and compliance-related guidelines to internal and external stakeholders.

•

Collaborate with departments including Tech Support, Registration, New Client Onboarding, Business Transitions, Business Consulting, Cash Management, and other business partners.

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements

•

2+ years of experience in Financial Services, Operations, Client Services, Technology Support, or a related field.

•

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

•

Experience supporting clients, business partners, or users through phone, email, or operational service channels.

•

Experience processing operational requests while maintaining accuracy and adherence to established procedures.

•

Ability to analyze information, troubleshoot issues, and communicate solutions effectively.

Core Competencies

•

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships.

•

Effective organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

•

Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational accuracy.

•

Analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to issue resolution.

•

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines and service expectations.

•

Ability to manage priorities while adhering to regulatory and firm requirements.

Preferences

•

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field.

•

Experience with Oracle, Documentum, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar enterprise platforms.

•

Experience using Salesforce, Adobe Professional, ASAT, or comparable business applications.

•

Familiarity with advisor technology platforms or financial services operations.

•

Experience supporting technology products, user access management, or operational workflows.

Pay Range:

$22.48-$37.44/hour

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.

For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.

Information on Interviews:

LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an @lplfinancial.com email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855) 575-6947.
